name: gau (getallurls)
what_it_holds: CLI (Go, MIT, 5.1k stars, 171 commits) that fetches all known URLs for a domain from Wayback Machine, Common Crawl, and AlienVault OTX in one pass; supports date-range and MIME filters, JSON output.
why_useful: One-command way to enumerate historical URL sets for competitor STR/OTA sites (Vrbo, Booking alt-accommodation, Sonder, Vacasa) across archives, e.g. to count listing/market pages seen over time as a rough supply/presence proxy (gap 9).
time_coverage: as far back as Wayback/CC coverage goes per domain
size_hint: tooling only; output size depends on domain
themes: Search/SEO and referral data: Bing/Google keyword volume tools, SERP scrapers, Common Crawl web graph, backlink datasets, AI-bot crawler traffic stats (Cloudflare, Vercel)
Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: One-command way to enumerate historical URL sets for competitor STR/OTA sites (Vrbo, Booking alt-accommodation, Sonder, Vacasa) across archives, e.g. to count listing/market pages seen over time as a rough supply/presence proxy (gap 9).

URL-discovery step to enumerate what paths ever existed under airdna.co, mashvisor.com, or insideairbnb.com (e.g. old market-report slugs, city pages that later moved/disappeared) before running a downloader against the Wayback Machine — feeds gaps #1/#2.

name: changedetection.io
what_it_holds: Self-hostable website change-detection app (~2,496 commits): watches arbitrary URLs, diffs content via CSS/XPath/JSONPath selectors, supports PDF and browser-rendered (Playwright) pages, and fires notifications (Slack/Discord/webhook) on change. No committed dataset -- it is a running service you point at target pages.
why_useful: Directly usable, no-code way to build a help-center / app-release-notes / newsroom change monitor for Airbnb (and comparators Vrbo, Booking, Vacasa) to catch product-launch and policy-change timing ahead of scraped confirmation -- fits gap #15 (product/patent/trademark & release monitors) as a generic acquisition method rather than site-specific script.
size_hint: single Python app, Docker image available
themes: Product-launch monitors: certificate transparency (crt.sh) tooling, app release-notes scrapers, Wayback diff tools, help-center change monitors, trademark/patent (USPTO, PatentsView) clients
why_all: Directly usable, no-code way to build a help-center / app-release-notes / newsroom change monitor for Airbnb (and comparators Vrbo, Booking, Vacasa) to catch product-launch and policy-change timing ahead of scraped confirmation -- fits gap #15 (product/patent/trademark & release monitors) as a generic acquisition method rather than site-specific script.

name: certstream-python
what_it_holds: Python WebSocket client for the CertStream network, which aggregates real-time Certificate Transparency log feeds (domain names, fingerprints, issuer, timestamps). 36 commits, MIT license.
why_useful: Real-time feed that could flag newly issued TLS certs for new Airbnb subdomains (e.g. a new product/microsite launch, an acquisition's domain going live, or a new country TLD) ahead of press coverage -- a leading indicator method for gap #15's product-launch monitor idea. Needs to run forward from now; can't backfill history.
themes: Product-launch monitors: certificate transparency (crt.sh) tooling, app release-notes scrapers, Wayback diff tools, help-center change monitors, trademark/patent (USPTO, PatentsView) clients
why_all: Real-time feed that could flag newly issued TLS certs for new Airbnb subdomains (e.g. a new product/microsite launch, an acquisition's domain going live, or a new country TLD) ahead of press coverage -- a leading indicator method for gap #15's product-launch monitor idea. Needs to run forward from now; can't backfill history.

name: crt.sh (Python wrapper)
what_it_holds: Small Python API wrapper (`crtshAPI().search('domain.com')`) around crt.sh's certificate-transparency search, returning certificate metadata (issuer, domain names, timestamps) for any queried domain. 20 commits, MIT license.
why_useful: Can backfill historical certificate-issuance history (crt.sh keeps a searchable CT log archive) for airbnb.com and subsidiary/product subdomains -- a point-in-time-flavored way to date when a new product domain first appeared, unlike the real-time-only certstream feed above.
time_coverage: however far crt.sh's CT log ingestion goes (years)
themes: Product-launch monitors: certificate transparency (crt.sh) tooling, app release-notes scrapers, Wayback diff tools, help-center change monitors, trademark/patent (USPTO, PatentsView) clients
why_all: Can backfill historical certificate-issuance history (crt.sh keeps a searchable CT log archive) for airbnb.com and subsidiary/product subdomains -- a point-in-time-flavored way to date when a new product domain first appeared, unlike the real-time-only certstream feed above.

name: sublert
what_it_holds: Python tool that leverages Certificate Transparency logs to automatically monitor and alert on newly deployed subdomains for a target organization. 1k stars.
why_useful: Purpose-built for exactly this theme's 'product-launch monitor via CT' idea -- point it at airbnb.com (and Vrbo/Vacasa/Sonder) to catch new subdomains signaling product or market launches before press coverage.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps certstream-python/crt.sh/certspotter for the CT-monitoring use case; this one is purpose-built for org-level subdomain monitoring specifically
